phase: Weapon runtime, pawn/HUD integration, unit and real-input PIE tests persisted; static checks passed; all new builds/tests unrun
baseline: Parent reports the previous flight/native/PIE slice passed before these weapons changes.
untouched: City, Performance, Effects and common DublinImpact.h were not modified.
Build.cs, config and assets were not modified.
Existing flight simulation and existing flight tests were not modified.
No builds, editor calls, issue operations, PythonRemoteExecution or delegation were performed.

runtime.cannon: Held LMB fires 7 Hz default, clamped 6-8 Hz; one launch per tick, no hitch catch-up burst. World-swept sphere projectile, forward speed 35000 cm/s plus aircraft velocity, 650 cm forward muzzle outside the 470 cm aircraft sphere. Local impact radius 200 cm and depth 50 cm.
runtime.bomb: B or RMB drop the same real sphere/UProjectileMovementComponent bomb; inherits full aircraft velocity, gravity scale 1, swept movement, forced 1/120 s substeps with 32 iterations. Spawn 540 cm below aircraft; no instant ground AOE. 1.5 s default shared cooldown, safely clamped 0.5-10 s.
runtime.yield: Visible EditAnywhere/BlueprintReadWrite BombYieldTonsTNT default 1; [ halves, ] doubles; finite clamp 0.1-1000. Game-only power curve with editable base radius/depth/strength, exponent and maximums. Hard bounds: radius 100-5000 cm, depth 10-2000 cm, strength 0.1-50. Monotonic game tuning, not real explosives engineering.
runtime.budgets: 32 active projectiles by default, hard maximum 64. Cannon lifespan 4 s, bomb lifespan 20 s; expired/destroyed weak references removed each tick; component EndPlay and test cleanup destroy owned survivors. Projectiles ignore aircraft and each other.
runtime.water: Cached city actor queried through GetWaterSurfaceZ at descending trajectory-segment surface crossings, with footprint confirmation and a bounded 100 cm/512-step search. Water crossing takes precedence over a later solid stop below the river. Underwater muzzle/drop starts resolve at the surface. Water remains nonblocking physics.
runtime.dispatch: Exactly-once gate shared by Tick water crossing and OnProjectileStop. Sends a finite normalized-normal FDublinImpact with kind, local radius/depth/strength/yield and seed. City ApplyImpact false increments rejection, logs/stores failure and does NOT emit accepted-impact FX. Accepted impacts request EmitImpact on the world subsystem.
runtime.visual_projectile: Existing Engine/EngineMaterials/EmissiveMeshMaterial is used as-is for a visible primitive tracer, without inventing an Emissive material parameter. No new material assets were authored; parent must inspect visual result.
runtime.lifetime: Weak cached city/projectile/component references; one city-actor lookup at component BeginPlay. Cleanup suppresses fire, releases input and removes active projectiles. Accepted/FX counters are not proof of visual destruction.

pawn_hud.controls: Native weapon bindings added without reusing Space/C, WASD, G or Home. G/Home, unpossession and input loss suppress held cannon; release/re-press re-arms.
pawn_hud.camera: Chase boom pitch bias changed from -8 to -18 degrees, clamped as before; actor rotation, heading, CalcCamera input orientation and GetViewRotation aim remain independent. New PIE assertion checks camera calculation does not mutate aim.
pawn_hud.hud: Compact weapon/yield/shot/active/accepted/rejected/ready/last-failure panel, visible weapon controls, smaller FPS panel with giant disclaimer removed; central reticle retained.
pawn_hud.credits: Small permanent (c) OpenStreetMap contributors; Survey Laefer et al., CC BY 4.0 line. F1 toggles inline full Content\Data\ATTRIBUTION.txt text; no browser launch. Missing file produces an explicit in-game/log fallback.
pawn_hud.aircraft: Existing interim silhouette retained; no final-art claim.

dependencies.build_cs: No new weapon-specific modules beyond existing flight/editor test dependencies. Retain conditional UnrealEd private dependency for Target.bBuildEditor. Parent must integrate any independent City/Effects dependencies before building.
city_api: Existing public bCityReady and BuildingCount are consumed.
dependencies.effects_api: UDublinImpactEffectsSubsystem derives from a world subsystem and exposes void EmitImpact(const FDublinImpact&). Included by its fixed header; parent compiles after parallel owner is ready.
dependencies.data: Content\Data\ATTRIBUTION.txt must remain available; existing city Content\Data staging applies to packaged builds.
